title: The email sender gets a claim link from Frequency before it mails a build item
description: Hunts with build on are held today because nothing fills the {{claim_url}} slot. The Owner asked on 10 Nov to build it: Frequency now answers a claim link for a signed build item (/api/webhooks/flowweb-claim) and never sends the message itself. senders/email.mjs gains claim: { url } in $FW_HOME/senders/email.json and reads the shared secret from FW_CLAIM_SECRET or the macOS Keychain (service flowweb-claim). A build item that is otherwise ready to send is first POSTed to that url as the outbox file's bytes, signed as hex HMAC-SHA256 of `${timestamp}.${body}` in x-flowweb-timestamp and x-flowweb-signature. built fills every slot with the claim link and the message goes out from the Owner's mailbox as before; suppressed moves the item to skipped/; refused or a 400/422 to failed/; off, a 5xx or no answer leaves it for a later pass. Without claim.url build items stay held; without the secret they wait and the sender exits non-zero.
acceptance: Without claim.url a build item is held and nothing is posted
Without the secret build items stay in the outbox, nothing is posted, the exit is non-zero, and plain items still send
Each build item is posted once, unchanged and correctly signed; built is sent with its claim link and no slot left; suppressed is skipped; refused fails with the reason; off and a 500 stay
